# Top Cleaning Team

> Professional residential, commercial, and specialty cleaning services across South Florida — owner-operated, fully insured, eco-friendly products, and a satisfaction guarantee on every visit.

Top Cleaning Team is a family-owned cleaning company serving Broward County, Miami-Dade County, and Palm Beach County. We provide recurring household cleaning, deep cleans, move in / move out preparation, post-construction detail, AirBnB / short-term-rental turnovers, and commercial / office cleaning.

Every service is delivered by background-checked, trained crews using eco-friendly, non-toxic products that are safe for children and pets. We carry full liability and worker's compensation coverage, and offer transparent pricing with no upsell surprises — the scope you quote is the scope you receive.

Booking is available online at /booking with instant pricing for most residential services. For commercial, move-in/out, or post-construction jobs, we provide a free custom quote within 24 hours of inquiry.

## Services

- [Residential Cleaning](https://topcleaningteam.com/services/residential): Recurring household cleaning — kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms, common areas. Weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly schedules available.
- [Deep Cleaning](https://topcleaningteam.com/services/deep-cleaning): Top-to-bottom intensive cleaning including baseboards, interior windows (up to 10), heavy stovetop scrub, and detailed kitchen tile + grout. Recommended for first visits.
- [Move In / Move Out Cleaning](https://topcleaningteam.com/services/move-in-out): Inspection-ready cleaning for property handoffs. Includes interior of refrigerator, oven, and cabinets plus garage and basement sweep.
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://topcleaningteam.com/services/commercial): Office and business cleaning with flexible after-hours scheduling. Restroom sanitation, breakroom care, high-touch disinfection, restocking.
- [AirBnB Turnover Cleaning](https://topcleaningteam.com/services/airbnb): Short-term-rental turnovers with fresh linens, towel changes, laundry service, essential supply restocking, damage inspection, and a photo report after every clean.
- [Post Construction Cleaning](https://topcleaningteam.com/services/post-construction): Final clean after renovations or new builds. Construction dust removal, paint splatter cleanup, window and track detail, fixture polishing, and final quality inspection.
